verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a point-of-sale product, but the evidence pack never documents issuing full or partial refunds to the original card from POS, the admin, or an API. The nearest items, cancelling orders and voiding payments at checkout and accepting exchanges, are adjacent features rather than refunds, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds back to the original card from the point of sale, dashboard, or API
